directoryIdentity.rule: The Directory slug is version-neutral and is never changed or treated as a protocol version.

majorLines.compatibilityPolicy: Only backward-compatible, re-tested fixes and additions are deployed on the v1 line.
This endpoint is created only by a future Product Owner decision for a breaking protocol, identity, OAuth or state-semantics change.

breakingChangeProcess: Open a new major-line design and threat review without changing v1.
Use a separate DNS name, OAuth audience, secrets, test fixtures and acceptance evidence.
Run MCP Inspector and real-Claude acceptance for the new major.
Keep v1 available during an explicit migration window.
Update Directory metadata and privacy statements through the Anthropic dashboard when the offered behavior changes.
Retire v1 only after documented migration, rollback and Product Owner approval.

anthropicCurrentBehavior.toolSurfaceUpdates: Anthropic currently says remote MCP tool changes are deployed to the live server without resubmission and are picked up on the next connection.
anthropicCurrentBehavior.semverDisclaimer: Anthropic does not define a SemVer or major-upgrade protocol for remote MCP connectors.
anthropicCurrentBehavior.slugRule: The Directory slug is permanent after publication.
